'''Celark''' was a soldier of the [[Tower Guard]].

== Appearance ==
He was lean, with light brown hair and thick fingers.

== Activities ==
Since returning to the [[White Tower]], Celark was one of a number of [[Younglings]] who decided that being a [[Warder]] was not the life for them. [[Gawyn Trakand]] tells them to report to [[Jimar Chubain]] to become a member of the Tower Guard.

When Gawyn returned to the White Tower, Celark followed him to [[Egwene al'Vere]]'s quarters. There they found some [[Bloodknife]] assassins, and Celark was beheaded in the scuffle.

== Trivia ==
* Celark is named for Fitzgerald Clark, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
